dedupe_keys.name: wec sim wave energy converter simulator

description: WEC-Sim is a wave-energy-converter simulator developed jointly by the National Laboratory of the Rockies and Sandia National Laboratories. It uses MATLAB, Simulink and Simscape Multibody to represent bodies, joints, power take-off and mooring systems. Time-domain equations resolve six Cartesian degrees of freedom and optional user-defined modes for flexible bodies. Users configure a converter and its wave environment, then obtain simulated motion and device response at the chosen time step. Coverage is global at device scale, without a fixed operating-site dataset. Source, tutorials and application examples are public and free under Apache-2.0; the required MATLAB products have separate commercial terms. A limitation is dependence on those external products and on the selected body and hydrodynamic representations. Published applications include desalination and mooring scenarios, but their results were not reproduced here. The software supports marine-energy design studies, complementary to offshore-turbine modelling represented by model-wtdigitwin-wind-turbine-digital-twin. No executable, model deck or application archive was downloaded.
